notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Performance & Stability
notes.content:
🧩 Fixed a major bug caused by a module-related issue.
 🧠 Made a minor memory optimization to improve overall performance.

Thank you for your continued support — more optimizations are on the way!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Critical Fixes
notes.content:
🧩 Fixed an issue where a specific module would not save correctly.
 🐞 Resolved a major bug affecting overall game stability.

We’re continuing to monitor for critical issues — thank you for your reports and patience!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Machine Management Improvements
notes.content:
📦 You can now box your machines and shelves to remove or relocate them more easily.
 💾 Implemented precautionary measures to prevent machine save-related issues.
 🛠️ Fixed a bug that caused machine duplication under certain conditions.

More improvements to management and stability are coming soon — stay tuned!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Module & Game Flow Fixes
notes.content:
🧩 Fixed an issue where some module effects were not functioning properly.
 ⏱️ Resolved a bug causing production time to display incorrectly.
 🔁 Fixed a bug where the game couldn't be started after returning to the main menu.

More stability and refinement updates are on the way — thank you for playing and reporting!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Save System & Logic Fixes
notes.content:
🧩 Fixed an issue where disconnected parts of machines were not being saved properly.
 ⏱️ Resolved a bug where production time could display as a negative value.
 🏷️ Fixed an issue where price tags would reset unexpectedly.
 🌙 Resolved a bug where customers could appear after midnight when reloading a game saved at midnight.

Thanks again for all the bug reports — your feedback helps us keep improving!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – UI & Visual Fixes
notes.content:
🖱️ Fixed a bug where the cursor would become invisible during gameplay.
 🧩 Resolved an issue where module effects were not displaying correctly.

We're committed to continuing polish and clarity — stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Miscellaneous Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
🧱 Fixed a bug where machines would unintentionally increase in size.
 🌐 Made improvements and updates to localization across various languages.


Thank you for helping us improve the game — more updates coming soon!

notes.title: New Update! - Trading Cards, New Workers, Delivery Box & more!
notes.content:
Here is the stuff we added:

Express Cargo Machine - Put items or yourself in it to get from the other side, no more walking - for a price.

New Workers & Managers - We added Cashier and Bodyguard!! And more managers too. Improve your staff!

Trading Cards and Community Items - Check out these beauties

Upgrading Machines - We noticed the machine's upgrades are not balanced, we adjusted the prices and their effects to emphasize the feel of progression.

Product Speed Multiplier - Products now have a different production time. For example first items have much more faster production time than the one you will unlock later in the game.

Module Price & Effect - Module Prices and effects are updated.

Also we fixed some bugs like product porter ai, production time display error, New Game Warning etc.

Please support us by leaving a review on Steam!! Also we'd love to hear your feedbacks and ideas, you can join our Discord server and let us hear them!

Cheers

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
In our last update, we accidentally added The Cashier to the game. With this hotfix, we’re removing him.
The Cashier mechanics are still a work in progress and not yet ready for release. This update will remove all related data for now. He’ll be added back in a future update once everything is working as intended and we’re fully satisfied with the implementation.
To those who purchased him and encountered issues — we’re truly sorry. We’ll be more careful with future updates to avoid situations like this. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Systems & UI Fixes
notes.content:
We’ve addressed several issues related to pricing, UI behavior, and NPC interactions to ensure a smoother experience:


 🔢 Fixed an issue where decimal values were not displaying correctly.
 ❌ Resolved a bug where the delete button wasn’t functioning properly, preventing price removal.
 💸 Fixed an issue where product prices would reset when stacking new items of the same type.
 🧾 Corrected a discrepancy between the price and total amount displayed on the cash register and POS.
 🛒 Fixed a bug where NPCs would take items on a tour around town before returning to purchase them.
 🏃‍♂️ Adjusted the movement speeds of the Product Porter and Shelf Organizer for better pacing.

Thanks for your continued feedback — we’re working hard to polish the experience even further!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We’ve continued improving the core systems and fixed several module and controller-related issues:

[olist]
 🧲 Fixed an issue where a module could get stuck in the player’s hand after being removed from a machine.
 ⚙️ Resolved a bug where machine updates did not apply to already installed modules.
 📈 Fixed an issue where certain modules were not calculating bonus profits correctly.
 💰 Resolved a bug where the POS system showed an incorrect amount when selling items with decimal values.
 🛒 Fixed an issue where the player couldn’t scroll down in the online market while using a controller.
[/olist]
More refinements and quality-of-life updates are on the way—thanks for your support!

notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We’ve addressed several controller-related and loading issues to improve your gameplay experience:


 🐛 Fixed an issue where the game could freeze during loading, causing your save file to fail to load properly.
 🎮 Resolved a bug that prevented the use of the POS device while playing with a gamepad.
 🛒 Fixed a bug that disabled scrolling in the market interface when using a gamepad.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! More improvements are on the way. 🚀
